evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Declarative act performing a settled operational rule — 'from now on' ratifies the cadence as load-bearing, not merely argued for.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Creed-level equivalence stated as bedrock identity — an unrehearsed rollback is defined out of existence; no hedge, no qualifier, constitutive framing.
Structural ratification of the cadence as a committed operational parameter — labeled, formal, settled.
Assignment of ownership ratifies the decision as load-bearing — naming an owner performs the settling.

mints.name: UnrehearsedEquatesToNonexistent
mints.title: what we have not rehearsed we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here asserting that an untested capability is definitionally absent — equating rehearsal with existence itself?
